decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, all dots pale, red X still beside the panel. The A-beat cost 6 mph (13 to 7) and left the car mid-junction, slightly left of the lane centre, nose angled a touch left of the road that climbs up-frame between bales and past a green O Petrol umbrella flag.
decision.hypothesis: The nose is only marginally off the road heading at low speed, and the corridor between the bales is wide from here, so plain throttle should carry the car up the exit without further steering cost.
decision.memory: W+A 0.8 s at 13 mph cost 6 mph mid-junction — confirms even short steers are expensive near the junction bales. Exit road climbs up-frame with bales on both shoulders.
